mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_check_result ( ai_decision_id, policy_code, trading_mode, account_no, stock_code, passed, fail_reason, available_cash, expected_order_amount, max_position_amount, current_position_amount, confidence, risk_reward_ratio, checked_at ) VALUES ( #{aiDecisionId}, #{policyCode}, #{tradingMode}, #{accountNo}, #{stockCode}, #{passed}, #{failReason}, #{availableCash}, #{expectedOrderAmount}, #{maxPositionAmount}, #{currentPositionAmount}, #{confidence}, #{riskRewardRatio}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, ai_decision_id, policy_code, trading_mode, account_no, stock_code, passed, fail_reason, available_cash, expected_order_amount, max_position_amount, current_position_amount, confidence, risk_reward_ratio, checked_at FROM risk_check_result WHERE ai_decision_id = #{aiDecisionId} ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, ai_decision_id, policy_code, trading_mode, account_no, stock_code, passed, fail_reason, available_cash, expected_order_amount, max_position_amount, current_position_amount, confidence, risk_reward_ratio, checked_at FROM risk_check_result WHERE ai_decision_id = #{aiDecisionId} AND trading_mode = #{tradingMode} ORDER BY checked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
